analysis: Documentation-only changes. docs/provider/cli-reference.md: the date was bumped (line 3), and head line 1741 adds DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED to the LaunchAgent passthrough table, read by libs/mlx-swift-lm GatedDelta.swift (GatedDeltaPrefill.mode). docs/reference/configuration.md: the date was bumped, and head line 414 documents the variable's values (0/false/no/off = stock; packed/rows = force; default probe) for the Qwen3.5-family Gated DeltaNet prompt kernel. The default probe reportedly keeps the four-row kernel only where it bit-reproduces gated_delta_step. The unit 8d39ffcfaa638a3c:0 had metadata only; I reviewed its content via the file_changes patch excerpt, which was truncated. The change is a kernel-selection performance tunable that passes from the operator shell to the daemon. It does not affect attestation, keys, routing, cache scoping, encryption or billing. The operator already controls local environment and weights (TB-003, T-007, T-012). A forced non-identical kernel could alter outputs, but that is within the existing T-007 provider-manipulation scope. The documentation does not claim output equivalence for forced modes. I identified no new trust boundary or invalidated assumption. Integration questions: (1) whether LaunchAgent.swift passthroughEnvKeys actually includes this key, which the source is not supplied to confirm; (2) whether forced packed/rows modes are numerically equivalent. Both are correctness and performance concerns, not security regressions. T-041 prefix-cache and TTFT behavior is unchanged; the name 'TTFT' refers to prefill speed, not the cache oracle.
